upheld.title: The story's signed-out journey is not run end to end
upheld.detail: The story's step is to open /user/login?returnUrl=//evil.example while signed out and then sign in as alice, so the original query string has to survive the [Authorize] OIDC challenge and the callback before LogIn.razor redirects. Every new and existing test signs in first and only then requests /us
upheld.requirement: Open http://localhost:18080/user/login?returnUrl=//evil.example and sign in as alice (Pass123$). Expected: after sign-in the user lands on a page of the WebApp

upheld.title: Test plans name the wrong scenario
upheld.detail: Seven plan files say the `auth-lockout` scenario is loaded, but the spec calls loadScenario('bug-5') and this PR adds testing/scenarios/bug-5/scenario.yaml. Plans and automation disagree on preconditions.
upheld.requirement: Test plans must describe the preconditions the automated test actually uses (qe-automation conventions, scenario per story).

upheld.title: Redundant double validation in OnInitializedAsync
upheld.detail: LocalReturnUrl already rejects non-local URLs, then OnInitializedAsync re-resolves against Nav.BaseUri and compares scheme/server again. Two overlapping checks add complexity without a comment explaining why both are needed.
upheld.requirement: No unexplained complexity or duplicated logic (critic check 2).

upheld.title: Coverage gap
upheld.detail: The design coverage marks video frames unverifiable (no readable videos). AGENTS.md requires a passing e2e video for browser-visible behavior, and the post-sign-in redirect is visible in the browser.

dismissed.title: Unit test file has a BOM and a story-specific name, and TC-07 shells out to nested Playwright
dismissed.reason: The critic withdrew it. .editorconfig:21 sets charset = utf-8-bom, so the BOM follows convention. The critic gave no evidence for the naming or nested-Playwright claims.
